title: Cao Pi Deposes the Emperor; Liu Bei Takes the Throne
summary: Emperor Xian, having been a hostage since he was nine, is made to abdicate in favour of Cao Pi with a ceremony of three refusals and three requests. Four hundred years of Han end on a raised platform in front of an audience that has been told what to shout.

In Chengdu the news arrives as a report that the Emperor has been murdered. Liu Bei goes into mourning, refuses the throne twice, and takes it on the third asking as Emperor of Han — the dynasty continuing, in his account, without interruption.
history: Historical. Emperor Xian was not in fact killed; he lived out a comfortable retirement and outlived Liu Bei by more than a decade, which nobody in Chengdu bothered to check.

pins.note: Founds Wei, and ends four centuries of Han.
Abdicates, and is widely reported dead.
Takes the throne on the third asking.
